categories.name: p2p
categories.evidence: Adds functional test coverage (`p2p_outbound_management.py`) for node-driven autonomous outbound connection management including stale-tip extra connections, feelers, and network diversification eviction.
categories.rationale: The PR adds functional integration test coverage for several previously untested autonomous outbound connection management features. This validates critical peer-connectivity behaviors (extra outbound for stale tip, block-relay feelers, and network diversification) without altering node code directly.

categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Adds the `auto_outbound_mode` feature to `test_framework.py` and deduplicates custom SOCKS5 proxy interception logic across functional tests.
categories.rationale: Extending the functional test framework to intercept autonomous node outbound connections provides a useful general testing capability. It unblocks integration testing for peer-discovery and connection-management logic while deduplicating custom proxy logic in tests.
